{{Quote|Captain Andor? They were looking for you. They're getting ready to power up the droid you brought in. The KX unit?|Corporal to Cassian Andor|<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />}}
A [[human]] '''corporal''' worked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at it's [[Great Temple|rebel base]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[2 BBY]]. Shortly after [[Mon Mothma]]'s speech denouncing the [[Galactic Empire]]'s role in the [[Ghorman Massacre]], the [[corporal]] was sent to notify [[captain]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] that [[Fay Drolla]] was ready to power up a [[KX-series security droid]] that Andor recovered from the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. They found Andor near the entrance of [[Great Temple]] and relayed the message to him.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Personality and traits==
This corporal had dark skin, short [[color|black]] [[hair]] and wore a tan [[jacket]] over a tan [[clothing|shirt]], blue pants, brown [[belt]] and brown [[boot]]s.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The corporal appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Ammar Duffus]] in the episode and credited as simply "corporal".<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
